title: NIST WebBook: Carbon Tetrachloride is CCl4, molecular weight 153.823 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Carbon Tetrachloride as CCl4, molecular weight 153.823 amu, CAS 56-23-5.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Carbon Tetrachloride, CAS Registry Number 56-23-5, lists molecular formula CCl4 and molecular weight 153.823 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 151.8754107 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/CCl4/c2-1(3,4)5. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
